deadline.value: Each advertised project sets its own deadline; two listed projects close 8 November 2026 and 31 August 2027.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: You highlight a potential supervisor, and an offer follows once a second supervisor is confirmed.
supervisor.quote: As soon as a second supervisor is confirmed, an offer will be sent to you through Pegasus, our online application system.

funding.value: Most listed projects are marked funded, but the page does not say whether funded places are open to international students.
funding.quote: Funding: funded AI-supported early stage design of certifiable systems for safety critical, disruptive technologies | Funding: funded Nature Inspired Acoustic Sensors & Devices

also.quote: The JARSS 2026/27 competition will open in November 2025 and students successful in this competition will commence studies in October 2026.

entry_route.value: The stated entry is an honours degree; the University's general page says research applicants normally have a Masters, so check with the department.
entry_route.quote: You'll need a first-class or upper second-class UK Honours degree, or overseas equivalent, in a relevant engineering, physical sciences or technology-based discipline from a recognised academic institution.

also.quote: If you wish to apply for a research degree you'd normally have to have a Masters degree and some experience of research work.

notes: Asks for a recent UKVI-recognised Secure English Language Test (SELT) if English is not the first language, rather than a band score. An EngD is also offered.
